more_info.overview: Fumaric acid is used as a raising agent in food. Its technological role is to release gas that increases the volume of dough.
more_info.uses: EU permissions include flavoured drinks, flavoured fermented milk products including heat-treated products, other confectionery including breath freshening micro-sweets, chewing gum. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
more_info.daily_intake: For fumaric acid: No ADI specified (JECFA, 1999). This evaluation does not establish an ADI for every form in the named group.
